subject: Pen test remediation update and evidence timeline (auth, secrets, network)
messages:
From: Kate Bradley <kate.bradley@bluefin.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: security@bluefin.com
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pen test follow-up: request for remediation status and evidence

Hi Diego,

Thanks again for the pen test engagement with PenTestCo. We've received the high/critical findings summary and need a remediation plan and evidence timeline to satisfy our internal compliance gate. Specifically we're tracking the following items from the report:
- Broken authentication / missing MFA on service console (High)
- Secrets leakage via config repo (Critical)
- Network segmentation gaps on prod VLAN (High)
- Missing centralized logging for platform agents (Medium)

Can you provide:
1) Current remediation status for each finding (brief description)
2) Target ETA for complete remediation and expected evidence artifacts (screenshots, logs, changelogs)
3) Any temporary mitigations you've applied in the meantime

We need the timeline by EOD Thursday so we can update our audit tracker. If you prefer a short call, happy to schedule.

Best,
Kate Bradley
Senior SecOps Manager
BlueFin Payments

Attachments: pen_test_summary_redacted.pdf (we can share full report once NDA permissions are set)
From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Kate Bradley <kate.bradley@bluefin.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pen test follow-up: request for remediation status and evidence

Hi Kate — thanks for the clear ask. Below is a concise remediation status and ETA per finding. I'll circulate artifacts as they become available; we expect to provide preliminary evidence within the windows below and a consolidated remediation packet when all items are closed.

Summary (owners, brief fix, ETA, evidence):
1) Authentication (owner: Diego Fernandez)
   - Fix: Enforced MFA for administrative console + tightened session TTLs. Rolled out conditional access rules for admin roles.
   - ETA: 2026-11-05
   - Evidence: admin policy screenshots, conditional access config export, session policy changelog
   - Temporary mitigation: Admin console access restricted to 2 IP ranges and step-up auth required for sensitive ops.

2) Secrets (owner: Dev Patel)
   - Fix: Rotate all service account keys, migrate secrets into managed vault with auto-rotation, and add pre-commit secret scanner in CI.
   - ETA: 2026-11-12 (rotation complete + scanner enforced)
   - Evidence: rotation changelog, vault access logs, CI scan run results (first two runs)
   - Temporary mitigation: Revoked exposed keys and applied short-lived tokens to affected services.

3) Network segmentation (owner: Dev Patel / Infra)
   - Fix: Hardened NACLs and host-based firewall rules between prod app and management plane; removed broad CIDR exceptions.
   - ETA: 2026-11-08
   - Evidence: network ACL diff, iptables snippets, deployment rollout record
   - Temporary mitigation: Applied emergency access rules and increased monitoring on affected subnets.

4) Logging & visibility (owner: Evelyn Hart)
   - Fix: Centralized agent logging routed to SIEM; extended retention for security events to 180 days; enabled agent-level debug for 7-day window during rollout.
   - ETA: 2026-11-02
   - Evidence: SIEM ingestion metrics, sample event traces, retention policy export
   - Temporary mitigation: Configured live-forwarding for critical alert types to on-call channel.

Next steps:
- We'll produce per-finding artifact bundles and upload to the shared Drive link (see below) as stages complete.
- Expect a consolidated remediation_packet_v1.pdf by 2026-11-13 containing redacted pen test report excerpts and all artifacts.

If you'd like a 30-minute sync to walk through proofs next week, I'm available Tue/Wed PST.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments (incoming): pen_test_report_redacted.pdf (received from vendor, awaiting full delivery)
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Secrets rotation plan + runbook (technical details)

Diego / team,

Following up with the technical plan for secrets remediation. Summary steps (high level):
- Identify all service principals with long-lived keys using inventory script (attached).
- Revoke compromised keys and issue short-lived tokens where supported.
- Migrate plaintext secrets from repo -> HashiCorp Vault (consul backend) using the migration helper.
- Add pre-commit hook + GitHub Actions step to run 'secret-scan' and fail PRs on high-confidence matches.

Runbook and artifacts attached: secrets_rotation_runbook.md, sample CI run output (first-scan.log). I'll push automation to rotate keys for the 5 most affected services by Monday 2026-11-01. Full sweep targeted for 2026-11-12.

Note: for any services that cannot yet support short-lived tokens we will implement network-level restrictions and strict IAM scoping as interim controls.

--
Dev Patel
Staff Software Engineer, Platform
Redwood Inference

Attachments: secrets_rotation_runbook.md, first-scan.log
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: security@bluefin.com, Kate Bradley <kate.bradley@bluefin.com>

Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Remediation packet (initial delivery)

Hi Kate / BlueFin team,

Attached is our initial remediation packet with artifacts for the items scoped so far. This is a curated bundle containing:
- authentication_policy_screenshots.png (admin policy export)
- secrets_rotation_audit.csv (redacted)
- network_acl_changes.diff
- siem_ingest_snapshot.json (sample events)

We are still finalizing a couple of items (full rotation evidence for remaining services and finalized pen test addendum from vendor). Expect the final packet by 2026-11-13 as Diego noted.

If you need any specific log ranges or additional signed attestations, let me know and we can prioritize.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Security Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Kate Bradley <kate.bradley@bluefin.com>

Cc: Timothy Lane <timothy.lane@bluefin.com>

Subject: Re: Remediation packet (initial delivery)

Marissa / Diego — thanks for the quick turnaround and the packet. This is helpful. A couple of follow-ups:
- Can you provide timestamped SIEM exports around the initial detection window (we need UTC timestamps and log hashes for audit)?
- For secrets rotation, we'll need the CI scan output with the false-positive tagging so our reviewers can reproduce the scanner results.
- We'll accept the remediation packet and will update our tracker after we review the attachments. Please send the final consolidated packet and the vendor pen test addendum when available.

Let's tentatively plan a 30-minute verification call next Thurs 2026-11-11 at 09:00 EST — I'll send an invite if that works.

Best,
Kate Bradley
Senior SecOps Manager
BlueFin Payments
